needed.evidence: A footway exists but is under 1m and partly obstructed by parked vehicles and impediments.
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, raised sidewalk on the left side to ensure a safe and usable pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: Informal path obstructed by motorbikes and other obstructions.
needed.suggestion: Clear and pave the informal path on the right side to create a fully usable pedestrian route.

needed.evidence: Broken and uneven sections on the footway near the parked cars.
needed.suggestion: Repair the trip hazards on the left footway to ensure a smooth pedestrian surface.

needed.evidence: Informal path showing uneven and potentially hazardous ground.
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the informal path on the right side to provide pedestrians with a safe walking surface.

needed.evidence: Crossing demand is present due to shops and residential proximity, but there is no crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Introduce a marked pedestrian crossing with a refuge to safely accommodate crossing demand in this area.

needed.evidence: Wide road with no refuge at any crossing point and multiple lanes.
needed.suggestion: Install refuge islands in the middle of the road to provide pedestrian safety on this wide and multi-laned street.
